Ocean area to beach length, ideally, would be close to its optimum. Fresh water is important. A variety of climates is preferable, as people have very different preferences, though extremes should be minimized. We give you our utmost thanks for any help you do choose to give us."

"You have suitable gravity for the terraforming. This should be easy. Syra, drop the nanites, and carve some nice mountain ranges." He projected a hologram from seemingly nowhere, and the men gathered around to watch as their planet sprung to life. "Here we have some alluvial plains, ripe for farming - and a large central mountain range for wind and solar power generation and mining. The oceans will be carved out soon enough and filled." In that moment, Centerpoint Station sprang to life, dragging a star 1AU away from Solos, and set it in orbit. The scrap from the excavation of the oceans floated up, propelled by massive gravity waves, and formed into a moon the exact distance that Luna was from Earth. In mere hours, the men stepped outside - onto a perfect replica of Earth.
"This is incredible," said Bullallin. "What power could do this but the divine? Who are you?"

"I am a wanderer from another time. Syra, what does Arbor say about growth potential?" "He thinks it's perfectly optimal, I've run my own tests and I feel the same way. The land is at max fertility." "Excellent. Your crops will prosper."
"Again, we thank you for your help. The human race is forever in your debt."
"Now, of course, this comes with a price. You are in full ability to refuse if you wish - do you want to hear it?"

"Some time in the future, maybe ten years, maybe a hundred, I will need a small group of settlers, roughly 1000, to come with me to a star system quite a far distance away and colonize it to serve as mechanics, engineers, and soldiers for a… defense system that I am working on. Anyone willing to volunteer can come along, and there is no restriction on the size of the group, but do know that I would prefer at least a thousand able-bodied individuals, roughly half men and half women. They will be provided for to the best of my capabilities in their new home, and the trip will take roughly ten minutes at most. At the time of settling, I'll set up a wormhole link between New Earth and the star system for transit between the two so they will always be able to return home if wanted. What do you say?"
"Perhaps. Would you like to announce yourself to the city? I'm sure once they know it is you who has done this thing they will be greatful, and you will have many volunteers when the time comes."

"Perhaps." With a smile he rockets upwards to greet the city, and in a boomy voice he announces what he has done and his intents and plans for the future. After a while, he finishes and descends to cheers.
